parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
beneficial[benəfiʃəl]adj.
If something is beneficial, it is good for you.
(Nếu một điều gì đó là beneficial, nó tốt cho bạn.)
→ Drinking milk everyday is beneficial to your bones.
2
birthplace[bə:rθpleis]n.
A birthplace is a place where a person is born or where something started.
(Birthplace là nơi một người được sinh ra hoặc nơi một điều gì đó bắt đầu.)
→ China is the birthplace of chopsticks.
3
capacity[kəpæsəti]n.
The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.
(Capacity của một vật là lượng thứ có thể được đưa vào trong đó.)
→ The parking lot has reached its full capacity.
4
comparative[kəmpærətiv]adj.
If something is comparative, it is being judged based on something else.
(Nếu một thứ là comparative, nó được đánh giá dựa trên một thứ khác.)
→ The money that John has is comparative to most other adults.
5
comprehensive[kɑmprihensiv]adj.
If something is comprehensive, it has all the details about something else.
(Nếu một điều gì đó là comprehensive, nó có tất cả các chi tiết về điều khác.)
→ The teacher gave us a comprehensive review for the exam.
6
conserve[kənsə:rv]v.
To conserve something is to protect it from being ruined or used completely.
(Conserve là bảo vệ cái gì đó khỏi bị phá hủy hoặc dùng hết.)
→ The group worked to conserve the beauty of Europe’s national parks.
7
crucial[kru:ʃəl]adj.
If something is crucial, it is extremely important to another thing.
(Nếu cái gì là crucial, nó cực kỳ quan trọng đối với một thứ khác.)
→ Clean air is crucial to the survival of humans, plants, and animals.
8
cumulative[kju:mjəleitiv]adj.
Cumulative describes an increase by adding one after another.
(Cumulative mô tả sự gia tăng bằng cách thêm cái này nối tiếp cái kia.)
→ The cumulative snowfall in the area is 50 centimeters per year.
9
deposit[dipɑzit]v.
To deposit something is to put it into a place or another thing.
(Deposit cái gì đó là đặt nó vào một nơi hoặc vật khác.)
→ I deposited the money into my bank account.
10
distribute[distribju:t]v.
To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.
(Distribute cái gì đó là phân phát nó cho nhiều người.)
→ The teacher distributed crayons and markers to his students.
11
equator[ikweitər]n.
The equator is an imaginary line that splits the Earth into north and south.
(Equator là đường xích đạo, một đường tưởng tượng chia Trái Đất thành bắc và nam.)
→ The equator crosses the northern part of South America.
12
exotic[igzɑtik]adj.
Exotic describes something unusual because it is from far away.
(Exotic mô tả cái gì đó kỳ lạ bởi vì nó đến từ một nơi xa xôi.)
→ Rebecca tried many exotic foods on her trip to Africa.
13
federal[fedərəl]adj.
If something is federal, it comes from the government of a country.
(Nếu cái gì đó thuộc về federal, nó đến từ chính phủ của một quốc gia.)
→ Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.
14
formation[fɔ:rmeiʃən]n.
A formation is the way that something is made.
(Formation là cách thức mà một thứ được tạo ra.)
→ The formation of ice happens when water freezes.
15
frequency[fri:kwənsi]n.
The frequency of something is the number of times that it happens.
(Frequency của cái gì đó là tần suất nó xảy ra.)
→ The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.
16
objective[əbdʒektiv]n.
An objective is a goal or plan that someone has.
(Objective là mục tiêu hay kế hoạch mà ai đó có.)
→ My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.
17
oxygen[ɑksidʒən]n.
Oxygen is a gas that all living things need to breathe.
(Oxygen là khí ô-xy mà mọi sinh vật sống đều cần để thở.)
→ My aunt believes that the oxygen in the country is cleaner than in the city.
18
rainforest[reinfɔ(:)rist]n.
A rainforest is a forest that is in a place where it rains very often.
(Rainforest là khu rừng ở nơi mưa rất thường xuyên.)
→ The rainforest is home to many animals.
19
strategy[strætədʒi]n.
A strategy is a plan for how to do something.
(Strategy là chiến lược hoặc kế hoạch để làm điều gì đó.)
→ The team came up with a strategy to win the game.
20
wooded[wudid]adj.
If an area is wooded, it is covered with trees.
(Nếu một khu vực là wooded, nó được bao phủ bởi cây cối.)
→ Jim and Ben decided to go hiking in the wooded area by the river.

sections.title: Part A: Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: 1. to give something away
questions.explanation: to give something away nghĩa là phân phát đi (distribute).

questions.content: 2. extremely important
questions.explanation: extremely important nghĩa là cực kỳ quan trọng (crucial).

questions.content: 3. where something begins
questions.explanation: where something begins nghĩa là nơi bắt nguồn (birthplace).

questions.content: 4. a person’s goal
questions.explanation: a person's goal nghĩa là mục tiêu (objective).

questions.content: 5. unusual and unfamiliar
questions.explanation: unusual and unfamiliar nghĩa là kỳ lạ, không quen thuộc (exotic).

sections.title: Part B: Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: 1. strategy
questions.explanation: strategy (chiến lược) nghĩa là một kế hoạch (a plan).

questions.content: 2. beneficial
questions.explanation: beneficial (có lợi) nghĩa là tốt cho bạn (good for you).

questions.content: 3. formation
options: the number of things inside something
questions.explanation: formation (sự hình thành) nghĩa là cách mà một thứ được tạo ra (how something is made).

questions.content: 4. federal
questions.explanation: federal (thuộc liên bang) có nghĩa là đến từ chính phủ (coming from the government).

questions.content: 5. conserve
questions.explanation: conserve (bảo tồn) nghĩa là bảo vệ (to protect).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the word that is similar in meaning to the bracketed part.

questions.content: 1. I like going to the park because it’s [covered with trees], and I feel like I’m in the mountains.
questions.explanation: covered with trees nghĩa là có nhiều cây cối, đồng nghĩa với wooded.

questions.content: 2. Sam [gave away] party invitations to his friends.
questions.explanation: gave away nghĩa là phân phát, đồng nghĩa với distribute.

questions.content: 3. The letter came from a [national government] office.
questions.explanation: national government liên quan đến chính phủ, đồng nghĩa với federal.

questions.content: 4. The business’s [goal] is to earn more money this year than it did last year.
questions.explanation: goal nghĩa là mục tiêu, đồng nghĩa với objective.

questions.content: 5. My mother grows [unusual and unfamiliar] flowers in her garden.
questions.explanation: unusual and unfamiliar nghĩa là kỳ lạ, đồng nghĩa với exotic.

questions.content: 6. He needed [gas required for breathing] to help him survive.
questions.explanation: gas required for breathing là khí ô-xy (oxygen).

questions.content: 7. This book about the history of India is [full of details].
questions.explanation: full of details nghĩa là đầy đủ chi tiết, toàn diện (comprehensive).

questions.content: 8. I’m going to visit a small town in Ecuador that is near the [imaginary line].
questions.explanation: imaginary line là đường xích đạo (equator).

questions.content: 9. The number of shoes that Jane and Beth have is [judged based on something else].
questions.explanation: judged based on something else nghĩa là đánh giá một cách tương đối (comparative).

questions.content: 10. Eddie didn’t want to eat it, but he knew the broccoli would be [good for his health].
questions.explanation: good for his health nghĩa là có lợi cho sức khỏe (beneficial).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Which word has about the same meaning as capacity?
questions.explanation: capacity (sức chứa) gần nghĩa với maximum amount (lượng tối đa).

questions.content: 2. Which of these can be cumulative?
questions.explanation: cumulative là tích lũy, tuyết (snow) có thể tích lũy rơi xuống thành đống.

questions.content: 3. What is something you would deposit into a closet?
questions.explanation: deposit là đặt vào, ta có thể đặt áo khoác (jackets) vào tủ quần áo.

questions.content: 4. What is something you probably wouldn’t encounter in a rainforest?
questions.explanation: rainforest là rừng nhiệt đới, kangaroos sống ở Úc (chủ yếu đồng cỏ/sa mạc), hiếm gặp trong rừng nhiệt đới.

questions.content: 5. In which place is there a high frequency of snowfall?
questions.explanation: frequency of snowfall là tần suất tuyết rơi, Nam Cực (Antarctica) có tần suất rất cao.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
A Dying Forest

Rainforests provide much of the world’s oxygen supply. But the forests’ exotic trees and animals are being killed to make room for farmers and roads. People have been trying to conserve rainforests for years. But another type of forest—the cloud forest—is just as beneficial to humans. Cloud forests are also in danger of disappearing, but little is being done to save them.

These forests are located at the tops of mountains, generally near the equator. These humid, wooded mountaintops are mainly in African and Central and South American countries. They are called “cloud forests” because their height allows for the formation of clouds among the trees.

Rainforests produce large amounts of oxygen. Cloud forests produce comparative amounts of water. The trees in these forests pull water out of the clouds. The moisture gathers on the leaves. When it drips, it is deposited into streams. The streams flow into towns at the bottom of the mountain. Then, it’s distributed to people. The yearly cumulative rainfall in these areas is 173-198 centimeters. Cloud forests can pull in up to 60 percent of that. This water is crucial to the plants and the people in the area. It helps them survive.

Cloud forests are also the birthplace of countless species of plants that can’t be found anywhere else. One small cloud forest has the capacity for as many types of plants as there are in all of Europe. There are so many, in fact, that scientists haven’t made a comprehensive list of them yet.

These forests are being destroyed with increasing frequency. Trees are being cut down, and roads are being built in their place. Some people have an objective to get federal money to protect the forests. But they have had little success. Another strategy is to replace the destroyed plants. That, too, has been difficult because the plants are so unique. There’s plenty of work to be done, but saving the cloud forests is still a possibility.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. Cloud forests provide much of the world’s oxygen supply.
questions.explanation: False. Rainforests provide much of the world's oxygen supply, not cloud forests.

questions.content: 2. Cloud forests are located at the tops of mountains, generally near the equator.
questions.explanation: True. The text states: 'These forests are located at the tops of mountains, generally near the equator.'

questions.content: 3. Cloud forests produce comparative amounts of water.
questions.explanation: True. The text states: 'Cloud forests produce comparative amounts of water.'

questions.content: 4. These humid, wooded mountaintops are mainly in European and Asian countries.
questions.explanation: False. They are mainly in African and Central and South American countries.

questions.content: 5. Cloud forests are the birthplace of countless species of plants that can’t be found anywhere else.
questions.explanation: True. The text explicitly mentions this.

questions.content: 6. One strategy to save the forests is to replace the destroyed plants.
questions.explanation: True. The text says: 'Another strategy is to replace the destroyed plants.'

questions.content: 1. What is true about cloud forests?
options: They are located at the tops of mountains near the equator.
They are mostly found in North America and Asia.
They produce the majority of the world's oxygen.
They are completely safe from destruction.
questions.explanation: The text states: 'These forests are located at the tops of mountains, generally near the equator.'

questions.content: 2. What do the trees in cloud forests pull out of the clouds?
questions.explanation: The text mentions: 'The trees in these forests pull water out of the clouds.'

questions.content: 3. Why are cloud forests being destroyed?
options: To create new species of plants.
To make room for farmers and roads.
questions.explanation: The text says trees are being killed 'to make room for farmers and roads', and similarly for cloud forests, 'Trees are being cut down, and roads are being built in their place.'

questions.content: 4. What is one strategy people use to try to save the forests?
options: Getting federal money or replacing destroyed plants.
questions.explanation: The text mentions two main strategies: getting federal money and replacing destroyed plants.
